description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseProvider' for API providers, implementing common functionalities such as tool schema conversion, token counting, and interface methods for creating messages and retrieving models. It includes methods for schema normalization and compatibility with OpenAI's strict mode.

classes.name: BaseProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for API providers, including schema conversion, token counting, and interface methods.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to create a message with a system prompt, messages, and optional metadata, returning an ApiStream.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve model information, returning an object with id and info.

methods.name: convertToolsForOpenAI
methods.description: Converts an array of tools to be compatible with OpenAI's strict mode, adjusting 'strict' flags and parameters based on tool type and name.

methods.name: convertToolSchemaForOpenAI
methods.description: Recursively converts tool schemas to comply with OpenAI's strict mode, ensuring required properties, handling nullable types, and normalizing schemas.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in content using tiktoken, can be overridden by providers for native token counting.
